Data extraction: Caddyfile directives as KeyValue nodes

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language:       `caddy`,
		DataExtraction: true,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`localhost
root * /var/www
file_server
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Data.Kind)
}
```
